description:
Terra Biophilic Design is a Toronto-based design studio specializing in handcrafted moss art and biophilic installations that bring nature into modern interiors. Our mission is simple: to create healthier, more inspiring spaces through the beauty of natural materials and thoughtful design.

Founded by a team of designers passionate about sustainability and aesthetics, Terra began by delivering custom large-scale moss walls for commercial environments—from corporate offices and hospitality venues to wellness and retail spaces. Today, we have expanded our expertise into a curated collection of moss art pieces designed for homes, workplaces, and design-forward interiors around the world.

Every Terra piece is meticulously handcrafted using 100% natural preserved moss, carefully selected for its texture, depth, and rich organic character. Through a specialized preservation process, our moss remains vibrant for years—without the need for watering, sunlight, or maintenance. The result is a living-inspired artwork that combines nature, design, and convenience.

Our brand stands for:

Design Excellence
We approach each piece as a work of art, balancing color, texture, and composition to create timeless designs that elevate interiors.

Natural Wellness
Biophilic design has been shown to support wellbeing, reduce stress, and improve focus. Our products bring these benefits into everyday environments.

Sustainable Craftsmanship
We prioritize responsible sourcing and durable materials to ensure our products are both environmentally conscious and built to last.

Premium Quality
From materials to framing to finishing, every detail reflects our commitment to high-end design and long-term performance.

Today, Terra Biophilic Design is trusted by designers, architects, businesses, and homeowners seeking distinctive natural décor that makes a statement. Our affiliate partners play a key role in sharing this vision—helping more people discover the transformative power of biophilic design.
